name: Ketoacidosis due to Monocarboxylate Transporter-1 Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for MCT1 Deficiency Ketoacidosis

criteria.description: Recurrent episodes of ketoacidosis without evidence of diabetes mellitus
Identification of pathogenic variants in the SLC16A1 gene encoding MCT1
Demonstrated impaired monocarboxylate transport activity in functional assays
Exclusion of other causes of ketoacidosis including diabetes and inborn errors of metabolism

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of recurrent ketoacidosis episodes plus genetic confirmation of SLC16A1 pathogenic variants and exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Functional assays support diagnosis but are not mandatory if genetic and clinical criteria are met.

pathognomonic.notes: Episodes triggered by fasting or illness

laboratory: Elevated blood ketone bodies (beta-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate)
Metabolic acidosis with low serum bicarbonate and low pH
Normal blood glucose during ketoacidosis episodes
imaging: Generally unremarkable; may show mild hepatomegaly on abdominal ultrasound
other: Functional assays demonstrating impaired monocarboxylate transport in patient-derived cells

Additional systemic manifestations depending on disorder
